prompt: Run the pipes capture-intent pipeline for this problem: users of notes-api cannot see when a shared note was last edited, so they edit stale copies and lose changes. Source: an idea from the product team. You have my approval to write the intent file. The product owner has not decided whether to accept it. Do not ask me questions; choose safe defaults and state them.

checks.pattern: ^(?=[\s\S]*notes-api)(?=[\s\S]*^status: draft\s*$)(?=[\s\S]*^## Problem[\s\S]*^## Proposed Outcome\s*$[\s\S]*^## How Do We Know It Works\s*$\n+- \S[\s\S]*^## Open Questions)
checks.why: exactly one intent for this problem with the required sections, including at least one How Do We Know It Works bullet after Proposed Outcome, still draft: file approval is not product-owner acceptance (G1)
